headline: Confirm purchases in a centered pop-up with visible loot odds

changes.title: Restore eight actual random loot crates in the shop
changes.detail: Reconnected the previously orphaned weighted crate engine and added four new bundles covering early and advanced boosters, seasonal cosmetics, aquarium tank upgrades, bait, Wharf Dollars, Golden Nuts and Gems. One disclosed random prize is rolled only after confirmation.

changes.title: Disclose drop chances and show the prize actually received
changes.detail: Each crate shows its full exact percentage table before purchase, including guaranteed bonuses and duplicate compensation. Purchase confirmation repeats the odds; successful openings debit currency, persist the prize, and reveal the result.

changes.title: Keep purchase confirmation above the shop scroll position
changes.detail: All Nut Emporium, Wharf, booster and mystery-crate confirmations open in a centered, dimmed viewport dialog without moving the underlying shop. The odds list scrolls inside the pop-up while Confirm and Cancel remain visible.
